title: 《雅琴看世界》英文專訪沈伯洋：洋流、城市交流與傾聽的力量
previous_context:
idn't invent the term "Yang-Liu", right? The ocean current — it's actually from our supporters. So I mean, for the international viewers, my name in Chinese is Shen Po-yang (沈伯洋), so the last character "Yang" (洋) means ocean.  
  * （首先我要先坦白一件事：「洋流」這個詞不是我發明的，對吧？「Ocean current（洋流）」其實是來自我們的支持者。對國際觀眾朋友說明一下，我的中文名字叫「沈伯洋」，最後一個字「洋」的意思就是海洋。）  
* **\[00:02:00\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：Okay.  
  * （好。）
text:
* **\[00:02:01\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：So that's why, I mean, people started to call the crowd at my events like "Yang-Liu". And then there are like two supporters, and they tried to — uh, they designed a poster with the color orange...  
  * （所以這就是為什麼大家開始把我們活動現場聚集的人潮稱為「洋流」。後來有兩位支持者，他們主動設計了一張橘色配色的海報……）  
* **\[00:02:13\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：Yeah, this one\! Actually, this is the one, yeah.  
  * （對，就是這張！現場畫面上這張就是，沒錯。）  
* **\[00:02:15\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：...yeah, the color orange, and white, and black. And then others tried to apply the same design to the ribbons. So, and then we have some supporters who tie the ribbons maybe on their scooters or on their wrists. So it just spread\!  
  * （……對，橘色、白色與黑色的設計。接著其他支持者又把同樣的視覺設計應用在飄帶上，許多支持者把飄帶綁在他們的機車上或是手腕上，結果就這樣一路傳開來了！）  
* **\[00:02:28\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：It just spread, yeah.  
  * （就這樣自然傳開了，沒錯。）  
* **\[00:02:30\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：And then, so I think it's the very first time I kind of feel like, "Hey, my name in Chinese actually has something to do \[with a movement\]\!" So it's kind of interesting.  
  * （所以我想這是我人生第一次感覺到：「嘿，原來我的中文名字還真的能跟一場運動產生連結！」我覺得相當有趣。）  
* **\[00:02:40\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：Uh-huh, uh-huh. But you have never imagined that this will happen, right? I mean, have you ever imagined that, you know, so many people get together to support you, and they just love you, they just want to give high-fives to you?  
  * （嗯哼。但你從來沒想過會發生這樣的事，對吧？我是說，你有想像過會有這麼多人聚集在一起支持你、這麼喜歡你，只想跟你擊掌嗎？）  
* **\[00:02:52\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：Yeah\! And then, so there's something I want to mention here is that, I think it's earlier this month, right? Because we're still in October — yeah, so earlier this month we opened our campaign headquarters. So I think that's the moment we entered the next stage of our election. Because I mean, they designed this poster, I mean, and then we went back to them at that time to see whether we can get permission to use that, and then we made it official when we opened the campaign headquarters. So we had like lots of supporters who raised like a huge banner, and has the characters saying "台北大洋流" — it's like "Taipei Big Ocean Current".  
  * （是啊！這裡有一件事我想特別提到，就是這個月初——因為現在還是 10 月嘛——這個月初我們成立了競選總部。我認為那是我們選戰邁入下一階段的關鍵時刻。因為支持者設計了這張海報，我們當時特地回去找原創者，詢問能否授權讓我們使用，並在競選總部成立大會上將它正式化。當天現場有非常多支持者共同舉起一面巨幅布條，上面寫著「台北大洋流」——也就是「Taipei Big Ocean Current」。）  
* **\[00:03:27\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：Yeah, "Great Taipei Current", something like that.  
  * （對，「大台北洋流」之類的意思。）  
* **\[00:03:30\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：Something like that\! So I mean, it's a huge banner, it's really amazing.  
  * （沒錯！那是一面非常巨大的布條，場面真的非常震撼。）  
* **\[00:03:35\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：And I saw you almost crying, is that right?  
  * （而且我看到你當時眼眶泛淚、差點哭出來，對嗎？）  
* **\[00:03:37\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：Right\! Because that's the feeling when — because you know that this ocean current doesn't really belong to me, because it's not like "Puma's crowd", right?  
  * （對！因為那種感動在於——你知道這股洋流並不是真正屬於我個人的，它並不是什麼「Puma 的群眾」，對吧？）  
* **\[00:03:45\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：Okay.  
  * （了解。）  
* **\[00:03:46\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：It actually started with the supporters, and then we made it official, so we collaborated with each other and to form this ocean current. So that's why I always mention — I also mentioned when we opened the campaign headquarters — we said that the ocean current is warm, and then we're inviting anyone. We never push anyone away. We didn't check, I mean, whether, "Hey, who did you vote for last time in 2022? Did you vote for Chiang?" No, we didn't do that, right? Because it's warm and it carries everyone along. I think that's the spirit of Yang-Liu.  
  * （它其實是由支持者自發開始的，接著我們將它正式納入，所以是我們與支持者彼此合作（collaborate），才共同匯聚成這股洋流。這也是為什麼我常說——在競選總部成立時我也特別強調——這股洋流是溫暖的，我們邀請所有的人，從來不把任何人推開。我們不會去檢查：「嘿，你上次 2022 年投給誰？你有投給蔣萬安嗎？」不，我們絕對不會那樣做！因為洋流是溫暖的，它帶著每一個人一起往前走。我認為這就是「洋流」真正的精神。）  
* **\[00:04:18\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：That's the spirit of Yang-Liu.  
  * （這就是洋流的精神。）

# **第 03 章｜第二題：遭中國列黑名單、重慶公安立案與在台跟監妻女——「台北市長由市民選出而非北京指定」（00:04:20 \- 00:07:45）**

* **\[00:04:20\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：But you know, on the other way, there are people they're not very happy about it. I want to talk about that — it is China. You know, uh, you've been blacklisted by China, and Beijing says that you're advocating Taiwan independence just like our President William Lai and Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim. Well, if you are elected as mayor of Taipei, do you think it will be a direct slap in the face of China, and what message that will bring to the international society?  
  * （但你知道，從另一個角度來看，有些人對此非常不開心。我想談談中國——你被中國列入了黑名單，北京指稱你跟我們的賴清德總統、蕭美琴副總統一樣都在倡議台獨。如果你當選台北市長，你認為這會是直接打臉中國（a direct slap in the face of China）嗎？這又會向國際社會傳遞什麼樣的訊息？）  
* **\[00:04:46\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：I think first, let's talk about the blacklist, yeah, right? So I didn't apply for it — I didn't apply, they gave it to me for free\! They gave it to me for free\!  
  * （我想首先我們先來談談這個「黑名單」，好嗎？我可沒有去申請——我根本沒申請，是他們免費送給我的！他們免費送我的！）  
* **\[00:04:55\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：They gave it to you for free\!  
  * （他們免費送給你的！）  
* **\[00:04:57\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：So, but I mean, it starts from — I think it starts from 2024, they put me on the list of "die-hard Taiwanese independence" guy, that's in 2024\. And in 2025, the police there in Chongqing, they opened a criminal case against me, right? And that's so weird — that's pretty weird — and they say they want to arrest me if I travel abroad.  
  * （對，但我是說，這件事大概從 2024 年開始，他們在 2024 年把我放進「台獨頑固分子」清單；到了 2025 年，重慶當地的公安居然對我展開刑事立案偵查，對吧？這真的很荒謬、非常詭異，他們還揚言如果我出國就要逮捕我。）  
* **\[00:05:19\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：Mhm.  
  * （嗯哼。）
